prompt: What was the birthday of the man who was mayor of New York City the year Snoopy debuted in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade?
answer: John Lindsay was mayor of New York City in 1968, when Snoopy debuted in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. He was born on **November 24, 1921**.
